2026-07-31T16:35:38.6881809Z     ### Batch Execution
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6882022Z     
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6882526Z     Execute multiple browser actions in a single request with optimized response handling and flexible error control.
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6883036Z

2026-07-31T16:35:38.6900689Z     #### Error Handling Options
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6900916Z     
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6901290Z     - **`continueOnError`** (per step): Continue batch execution even if this step fails
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6901842Z     - **`stopOnFirstError`** (global): Stop entire batch on first error
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6902330Z     - Flexible combination allows for robust automation workflows
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6902666Z     
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6902884Z     ### Tool-Specific Defaults
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6903119Z     
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6903425Z     Each tool has optimized defaults based on typical usage patterns:
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6903774Z     
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6904132Z     - **Navigation tools** (`browser_navigate`): Include full context for verification
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6904761Z     - **Interactive tools** (`browser_click`, `browser_type`): Include snapshot but minimal logging
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6905646Z     - **Screenshot/snapshot tools**: Exclude additional context
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6906122Z     - **Code evaluation**: Include console output but minimal other info
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6906571Z     - **Wait operations**: Minimal output for efficiency
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6906867Z     
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6907062Z     ### Performance Benefits
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6907290Z     
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6907649Z     - **Token Reduction**: 50-80% reduction in token usage with optimized expectations
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6908352Z     - **Faster Execution**: 2-5x speed improvement with batch execution
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6908852Z     - **Reduced Latency**: Fewer round trips between client and server
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6909353Z     - **Cost Optimization**: Lower API costs due to reduced token consumption
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6909718Z     
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6909934Z     ### Response Diff Detection
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6910166Z     
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6910685Z     The Fast Server includes automatic diff detection to efficiently track changes between consecutive tool executions:
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6911217Z     
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6911392Z     ```json
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6911585Z     {
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6911801Z       \"name\": \"browser_click\",
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6912058Z       \"arguments\": {
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6912320Z         \"element\": \"Load more button\",
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6912620Z         \"ref\": \"#load-more\",
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6912878Z         \"expectation\": {
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6913140Z           \"includeSnapshot\": true,
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6913534Z           \"diffOptions\": {
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6913788Z             \"enabled\": true,
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6914045Z             \"threshold\": 0.1,
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6914313Z             \"format\": \"unified\",
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6914590Z             \"maxDiffLines\": 50,
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6914838Z             \"context\": 3
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6915220Z           }
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6915414Z         }
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6915594Z       }
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6915770Z     }
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6915944Z     ```
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6916115Z     
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6916322Z     #### Diff Detection Benefits
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6916564Z     
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6916924Z     - **Minimal token usage**: Only changed content is shown instead of full snapshots
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6917479Z     - **Change tracking**: Automatically detects what changed after actions
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6918024Z     - **Flexible formats**: Choose between unified, split, or minimal diff formats
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6918578Z     - **Smart caching**: Compares against previous response from the same tool
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6918949Z     
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6919160Z     #### When to Use Diff Detection
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6919406Z     
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6919736Z     1. **UI interactions without navigation**: Clicks, typing, hover effects
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6920257Z     2. **Dynamic content updates**: Loading more items, real-time updates
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6920724Z     3. **Form interactions**: Track changes as users fill forms
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6921218Z     4. **Selective monitoring**: Use with CSS selectors to track specific areas
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6921591Z     
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6921767Z     ```json
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6921955Z     {
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6922172Z       \"name\": \"browser_type\",
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6922429Z       \"arguments\": {
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6922688Z         \"element\": \"Search input\",
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6922963Z         \"ref\": \"#search\",
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6923232Z         \"text\": \"playwright\",
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6923487Z         \"expectation\": {
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6923754Z           \"includeSnapshot\": true,
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6924042Z           \"snapshotOptions\": {
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6924348Z             \"selector\": \"#search-results\"
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6924621Z           },
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6924823Z           \"diffOptions\": {
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6925209Z             \"enabled\": true,
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6925477Z             \"format\": \"minimal\"
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6925725Z           }
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6925905Z         }
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6926086Z       }
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6926261Z     }
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6926434Z     ```
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6926609Z     
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6926792Z     ### Best Practices
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6927001Z     
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6927258Z     1. **Use batch execution** for multi-step workflows
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6927683Z     2. **Enable diff detection** for actions without page navigation
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6928409Z     3. **Disable snapshots** for intermediate steps that don't need verification
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6928934Z     4. **Use selective snapshots** with CSS selectors for large pages
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6929372Z     5. **Filter console messages** to relevant levels only
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6929858Z     6. **Combine global and step-specific expectations** for fine-grained control
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6930344Z     7. **Use minimal diff format** for maximum token savings
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6930650Z

2026-07-31T16:35:38.6940180Z     ### Network Request Filtering
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6940417Z     
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6941048Z     The `browser_network_requests` tool provides advanced filtering capabilities to reduce token usage by up to 80-95% when working with network logs.
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6941683Z     
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6941870Z     #### Basic Usage Examples
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6942103Z     
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6942275Z     ```json

2026-07-31T16:35:38.6944176Z

2026-07-31T16:35:38.6944877Z       \"name\": \"browser_network_requests\", 
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6945516Z       \"arguments\": {
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6945878Z         \"excludeUrlPatterns\": [\"analytics\", \"tracking\", \"ads\"]

2026-07-31T16:35:38.6947505Z       \"arguments\": {
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6947798Z         \"statusRanges\": [{ \"min\": 200, \"max\": 299 }]
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6948099Z       }
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6948277Z     }
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6948593Z

2026-07-31T16:35:38.6950592Z       }

2026-07-31T16:35:38.6962301Z     #### Token Optimization Benefits
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6962551Z     
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6962879Z     - **Massive reduction**: 80-95% fewer tokens for large applications
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6963351Z     - **Focused debugging**: See only relevant network activity
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6963843Z     - **Performance monitoring**: Track specific endpoints or error patterns
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6964344Z     - **Cost savings**: Lower API costs due to reduced token usage
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6964673Z     
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6964889Z     #### When to Use Network Filtering
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6965281Z     
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6965578Z     1. **API debugging**: Focus on specific endpoints and methods
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6965988Z     2. **Error monitoring**: Track only failed requests
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6966440Z     3. **Performance analysis**: Monitor slow or problematic endpoints  
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6966912Z     4. **Large applications**: Reduce overwhelming network logs
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6967432Z     5. **Token management**: Stay within LLM context limits
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6967832Z     
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6968272Z     ### Migration Guide
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6968502Z     
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6968811Z     Existing code continues to work without changes. To optimize:
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6969148Z     
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6969519Z     1. Start by adding `expectation: { includeSnapshot: false }` to intermediate steps
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6970018Z     2. Use batch execution for sequences of 3+ operations
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6970462Z     3. Gradually fine-tune expectations based on your specific needs
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6970934Z     4. Use diagnostic tools when automation fails or needs debugging
2026-07-31T16:35:38.6971586Z     5. Set `--tool-profile=full` before upgrading when a client depends on the complete static `tools/list` response.
